name: fullpilot-warmbly
description: Fullpilot's fork of Warmbly. npm scripts wrap the upstream Makefile for dev and add Fullpilot's build + deploy pipeline to Google Cloud.

scripts.fleet: bash deploy/fullpilot/ssh.sh 'cd /opt/warmbly && sudo docker compose -p warmbly exec backend warmblyctl fleet list'
scripts.prod:logs: bash deploy/fullpilot/ssh.sh 'cd /opt/warmbly && sudo docker compose -p warmbly logs --tail 200'
scripts.prod:ps: bash deploy/fullpilot/ssh.sh 'cd /opt/warmbly && sudo docker compose -p warmbly ps'
scripts.upstream:sync: git fetch upstream --tags && git checkout main && git merge --ff-only upstream/main && git push origin main && git checkout fullpilot
